deliverable: Fix the Rust formatting failure; isolate runner-generated Linux and Windows caches from the exact monitored app-data roots while continuing to snapshot every explicit app-owned root; keep macOS Canvas app-data byte-identical through its text-entry flow; make all eframe persistence evidence summary-only; and retain complete structured failure snapshots and deltas.
scope: Apply the exact cargo fmt correction reported by Ubuntu Rust CI without unrelated formatting churn.

On Linux Canvas runs, direct Mesa shader cache output to a run-scoped sibling scratch root outside appDataContainer and the selected vault. Continue monitoring the XDG config, data, state, and cache roots exactly; do not allowlist Mesa paths. Verify every scratch root is canonical and outside the vault before launch.

On Windows Canvas runs, put USERPROFILE and LOCALAPPDATA in run-scoped sibling roots outside appDataContainer so Explorer icon-cache and Microsoft Windows cache writes are not part of the app-data tree. Explicitly prove both scratch roots are canonical and outside appDataContainer and the selected vault. Keep APPDATA and its OpenObsidian app root under the monitored appDataContainer. Explicitly monitor APPDATA/OpenObsidian, the observed USERPROFILE/AppData/Roaming/OpenObsidian root, and the candidate USERPROFILE/AppData/Local/OpenObsidian and LOCALAPPDATA/OpenObsidian roots so moving the profile does not hide app-owned data; report whether candidate roots are absent or empty. Snapshot the union of appDataContainer and those exact app-owned roots, with stable logical path prefixes, and prove every external app-owned root is canonical and outside the selected vault. Apply the complete .ron discovery/path policy across this union and reject every app.ron on Windows. Do not add broad path exemptions.

For the macOS Canvas text-edit CI profile only, set OPENOBSIDIAN_CI_CANVAS_DISABLE_EGUI_MEMORY_PERSISTENCE=1 in the harness child-process environment and implement the matching UI-runtime hook so OpenObsidianApp::persist_egui_memory returns false only when that flag is exactly enabled. Keep NativeOptions.persist_window and all normal product defaults enabled, keep Linux/Windows behavior unchanged, and leave the separate C07.4 app.ron persistence/reference scenarios unchanged. Because the app has no custom App::save data, the macOS Canvas profile should retain native window persistence while excluding potentially sensitive transient text-edit/undo memory. Record the effective persistence policy in the Canvas app-data report. Update app.ron inspection to require the exact macOS path, a present window section, an absent egui-memory section only in this profile, and all existing forbidden-path checks; retain current section expectations in every other profile. Retain the post-picker baseline and exact full-tree equality assertions through macOS field input, draft load/edit, explicit save, and process close; Linux expected-abort acceptance remains in its separate canary profile. Do not permit an app.ron exception.

Keep raw RON text in memory only for existing structural and forbidden-path inspection. Ensure every serialized eframe persistence record contains metadata/inspection summaries only (path, byte count, SHA-256, parsed section/check results), never a content field. Add a GitHub CI-path assertion over the final report tree used for JSON serialization, recursively including every nested and duplicate eframe persistence alias, which fails if a raw content field remains.

When app-data phase validation fails, retain complete structured before/after snapshots and path deltas in the CI report, using path/kind/byte-count/hash metadata only. Keep an error summary, but do not truncate away the only per-path evidence or serialize file contents.

Preserve all R3.6 exact click-event/frame/watermark behavior, the full R3.5 expected-abort/recovery/clipboard/vault-preservation contract, exact marker bytes and vault IDs, and all C07.4 reference acceptance.

Changing the app.ron equality policy to allow an unexplained macOS delta.
Adding cache-path allowlists or excluding an app-owned data root without an explicit snapshot.
Rewriting prior evidence or copying raw RON contents into committed reports.
C07.5/C09 work or any unrelated migration scope.

review_findings.finding: The initial plan needed an explicit USERPROFILE/AppData/Local/OpenObsidian candidate root, canonical/outside-vault checks for both Windows scratch roots, a concrete Rust hook for the macOS eframe policy, and an app.ron profile rule consistent with egui-memory being absent.
review_findings.resolution: Added both USERPROFILE and LOCALAPPDATA OpenObsidian candidate roots; required scratch and app-owned root containment checks; named the harness flag and OpenObsidianApp::persist_egui_memory mapping; and made the macOS window-present/egui-absent policy explicit while preserving other profiles.

review_findings.finding: No blocking regression found; ensure the privacy guard checks the final serialized report tree, including nested aliases, and make the environment-flag-to-App::persist_egui_memory mapping explicit.
review_findings.resolution: The scope now requires the final JSON serialization tree to be traversed recursively and names the exact flag and false-returning App method; window persistence and the dedicated C07.4 report flow remain enabled.

review_findings.finding: The previous Windows setup created USERPROFILE/AppData/Roaming/OpenObsidian/data before the app-data baseline, so the exact observed app-owned folder could otherwise look like an unexplained runtime change.
review_findings.resolution: The harness recreates only that exact empty directory before the baseline and records its logical path and initial-empty state in the root inventory.

review_findings.finding: The initial Canvas app-data snapshot was assigned after preflight checks, so those failures could omit it; inherited persistence flags could also affect non-target child launches.
review_findings.resolution: Snapshot and root inventory are attached before prelaunch validation, all app-data preparation/canonicalization/snapshot/validation work shares a failure-evidence handler, and launchLogged strips the opt-out flag by default, allowing exact value 1 only for the normal macOS Canvas text-edit launch.

review_findings.finding: Root setup, canonicalization/disjointness checks, and initial snapshot capture originally ran before the structured evidence handler.
review_findings.resolution: The complete app-data preflight now runs under one catch that records its stage, configured and available canonical roots, any safe baseline snapshot, and the error. Host-noise snapshot failures preserve the snapshot produced by snapshotTree; preflight deltas are null when no post-failure snapshot exists. Focused follow-up review found no remaining blocker.

review_findings.finding: No blockers in summary-only serialization, exact macOS persistence opt-out scoping, or Rust runtime mapping.
review_findings.resolution: Confirmed the final serialized report is recursively guarded, the child launch only permits the exact opt-out on the intended macOS Canvas profile, and window persistence remains enabled.
